metas.name: Least Eligible Bachelor
metas.description: A bachelor struggling to find a bride because of his looks moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start, only to discover that his potential match is his colleague at work.

metas.name: Amrutham
metas.description: Amrutham is a popular sitcom in Telugu. It was produced by Just Yellow Media. It was the longest running and most popular sitcom in Telugu.

metas.name: 3 Roses
metas.description: Story of 3 best friends – Ritu, Jhanvi, and Indu who reunite when their families call them back to Hyderabad to get the girls married & settled. During this process, they happen to witness a series of events that change their life.

metas.name: Super Subbu
metas.description: An unlucky teacher is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village. Can he balance this secret while chasing his dreams and saving his relationship?

metas.name: Second Marriage
metas.description: Second Marriage is an emotional romantic comedy about two beautifully imperfect people who give marriage another chance. Packed with quirky humor, heartfelt emotions, and relatable moments, the series feels like a warm hug.

metas.name: Brahma Mudi
metas.description: The lives of Kavya and her sisters change forever as they cross paths with the Duggiraala brothers. As fate brings them closer, what's in store for them?

metas.name: Devika & Danny
metas.description: Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

metas.name: AIR
metas.description: Three boys. One elite college. A system that demands perfection. Arjun, Imran, and Raju come from different worlds but share one secret: they don’t want to be here. As rebellion sparks friendship, their bond deepens amid pressure, heartbreak, and identity struggles. Guided by a radical teacher with a troubled past, they must decide who they truly are—beyond marks and expectations.

metas.name: Hello World
metas.description: Eight youngsters join a renowned IT company assuming that their struggles are over. But, their excitement is short-lived when they realise that life has more in store for them than they had imagined.

metas.name: Save the Tigers
metas.description: Revolves around three frustrated husbands who meet by chance and how their rants over their marital problems set off a series of crazy events.

metas.name: Bad Trip
metas.description: A shared cab ride presents a group of people the opportunity to get rich quickly. What seems like an easy job turns into a web of nightmares for the gang.

metas.name: Hometown
metas.description: A filmmaker revisits his hometown, remembering childhood moments that shaped him - first love, lasting friendships, his initial plane ride, and early heartaches that influenced who he became.

metas.name: Thulasivanam
metas.description: This IPL season meet the Party animal Thulasi Ram from Thulasivanam.

metas.name: Oka Chinna Family Story
metas.description: Mahesh and his mother embark on an adventurous journey filled with hilarious situations as they try to make quick money to repay a huge loan.

metas.name: Anveshana
metas.description: An undercover investigating organization called UBI , is secretly operating in india with no one having clue about it except the agents themselves.One among the expert level agents is Mr.Ravi who works for UBI under a psuedo identity - Agent chanakya.Watch Anveshana , a spy comedy thriller webseries which deals with exposing the Honeytrap mafia.

metas.name: Yakshini
metas.description: A spirit named Maya, cursed to live among mortals as punishment for a wicked deed, embarks on a mission to sacrifice 100 men to save her kind, but her resolve wavers when she encounters a kind-hearted young man named Krishna.

metas.name: Meet Cute
metas.description: Meet Cute takes you through five instances of Two strangers, unexpectedly, find solace in each other’s company while navigating through tricky phases in their lives, helping them look at themselves and their loved ones in a different light.

metas.name: Surya
metas.description: The show follows the story of Surya, a middle-class youngster struggling to find a decent job but to his misfortune, he never achieves any success at the task.

metas.name: Maya Bazaar - For Sale
metas.description: High expectations of the buyers turn upside down when "Maya Bazaar", a gated community’s brand ambassador – a celebrity actor Abhijeet - falls dead from the terrace of the clubhouse on the inauguration day. On the same day, the residents also come to know that the entire property is illegal and their hope for a peaceful life comes to a standstill when the government declares the construction illegal.

metas.name: Kumari Srimathi
metas.description: Srimathi is a 30 year old unmarried woman, with a dead end job, a dysfunctional family and a goal to win back her ancestral house. For that, she needs to raise a lot of money in a short period of time. Seeing a business oppurtunity, she decides to start a bar in her village. This is the journey of Srimathi, battling various societal and moral obstacles along the way.

metas.name: Bujji & Bhairava
metas.description: It's the year 2896, in future city of Kasi, Bhairava is a bounty hunter with dreams of getting into the Complex, and BU-JZ1, an AI pilot of a Cargo ship, waiting for her promotion. At their lowest point, these two unlikely souls, find each other to set off a crackling story of ambition, adventure, partnership and mainly friendship.

metas.name: Anger Tales
metas.description: An anthology bringing alive the various hues of anger, telling the stories of four ordinary people belonging to different socio-economic backgrounds.

metas.name: Aha Naa Pellanta
metas.description: Seenu, a young man who is desperate for marriage, lands at a suitable match with great difficulty. While he's relieved about tying the knot at last, comes the twist, when the bride elopes with her boyfriend.

metas.name: Memu Copulam
metas.description: When a village’s star rooster vanishes, clueless cops Ravi and Mohan take the lead to solve the case. What starts as a hilarious search leads them to a conspiracy that threatens the entire community.

metas.name: Modern Love Hyderabad
metas.description: A new generation of love stories, the love and fascination between the lovers, the dynamics of their relationships, their funny conversations and their conflicts.

metas.name: Maa Neella Tank
metas.description: In Buchivolu village, Sarpanch Kodandam's son Gopal threatens to jump off a water tank for his crush Surekha. With his image and career at stake, Kodandam appoints SI Vamshi to find Surekha, who is missing.

metas.name: #90’s - A Middle Class Biopic
metas.description: A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

metas.name: Temporary Roommates
metas.description: Sandeep and Karthik are roommates, who are living peacefully in their lives. Everything changes when an Uninvited guest, a girl enters their flat and lives.

metas.name: Sivarapalli
metas.description: Shyam, an engineering graduate from Hyderabad, reluctantly takes up the job of Panchayat Secretary in Sivarapalli, a remote village in Telangana, due to a lack of job options. The show follows Shyam as he navigates the idiosyncrasies and absurdities of village life and his job while preparing for the GMAT, hoping to leave the village and move to the USA.

metas.name: Nuvvu Evaru
metas.description: An NRI techie reunites with his wife after her two-month Indian vacation only to realize that her behavior, habits and actions have significantly changed. And hours later, his actual wife arrives.

metas.name: The Software DevLOVEper
metas.description: A group of four people including Shannu work in a software company when a new girl, Vaishnavi, joins their team. Shannu falls in love with Vaishnavi and tries to spend time with her but she treats him like a friend.

metas.name: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam
metas.description: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam is a 2020 ZEE5 Telugu Original comedy series starring Harsha Vardhan, L B Sriram, Vasu, and Sivannarayana. In this sequel of Amrutham, the all-time popular Telugu sitcom, Amrutham and Anji continue to come up with creative ideas for their restaurant and fail with hilarious consequences.

metas.name: Arthamainda Arun Kumar
metas.description: Arun Kumar Mundha, Intern of the Year, knows Hyderabad is the city where all your dreams come true. On his long journey from Amlapuram to Hyderabad through love and loss, he learns, 'We don't fit in, we have to make our own place
